title: August Jobs Report Crushes Estimates: Payrolls +162K vs. 53K Forecast, Unemployment Holds at 4.1%
summary: U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August, tripling the 53,000 consensus estimate; July was revised upward. Unemployment held at 4.1%. The blowout report immediately pushed Fed rate hike probability to ~60% for the Sep 15–16 FOMC meeting, with Treasury yields surging and equity futures slipping.
why: 就业报告大幅超预期，9月FOMC加息25bp概率升至60%；本周五CPI是最终决定性指标。对以sell put为主的期权策略，需关注加息落地后成分股隐含波动率变化，以及港股（HKD联系汇率压力）和A股的联动影响；行权价安全边际需重评。

title: Trump Ramps Up Pressure on Fed Chair Warsh; Markets Price 60% Odds of September Rate Hike
summary: Following the blowout August jobs report, markets priced ~60% odds of a 25bp hike at the Sep 15–16 FOMC. President Trump, VP, Treasury Secretary, and senior economic advisors all publicly urged the Fed not to hike — an unusually broad political campaign. CME FedWatch put hike probability at 60.4%. CPI data due Friday is the next pivot.
why: 政治压力与市场定价的分歧加大了9月FOMC不确定性。若CPI超预期则加息定局，高成长科技股（NVDA/GOOGL/科技持仓）面临估值下修；sell put策略需关注期权行权价安全边际，特别是9月15日财报密集期前的波动率。

title: U.S. Strikes Iranian Crude Carriers; Oil Spikes, Markets Reprice Geopolitical Risk
summary: Late Sunday, U.S. forces struck Iranian crude oil carriers, escalating the US-Iran conflict ongoing since February 2026. Brent crude rose sharply; Bitcoin fell as risk-off sentiment spread. Strait of Hormuz disruption risk is now elevated, compounding the existing oil price shock that has pushed crude toward $97/bbl.
why: 美军打击伊朗油轮是本轮美伊冲突（2026年2月以来）的重大升级，直接推升油价。油价通胀二次抬头将强化Fed加息逻辑；同时对消费类持仓（麦当劳、海底捞、携程等）构成成本压力；卖出期权策略须警惕地缘事件驱动的波动率尖峰。

title: $320 Million Bitcoin Exploit Hits Liquid Network; Sidechain Halts All Transactions
summary: A purported white-hat hacker withdrew ~4,000 BTC ($320M) from Liquid Network's federation wallet by exploiting a software bug in Elements. The Bitcoin sidechain — used by exchanges as a settlement layer — halted all new transactions. The hacker has offered conditional return of funds once the vulnerability is patched. Bloomberg confirmed the exploit.
why: 加密货币基础设施重大安全事件，影响以Liquid Network为结算层的交易所（含富途牛牛合作平台）；若资金无法追回将冲击市场信心。Circle（USDC）、Coinbase等相关标的短期不确定性上升；波动率看涨。

title: Bitcoin Holds $79K as Rate-Hike Odds Climb; Zcash Surges 45% in a Week, Crypto Eyes CPI
summary: Bitcoin traded at $79,300–79,700 Monday morning, down ~1% from midnight UTC, as ~60% Fed hike odds weighed on risk assets (US Labor Day holiday). Zcash (ZEC) cleared $1,000 for the first time since 2016, rising 45% on the week. Coinbase switching perpetuals venue to Deribit this week. CPI Friday is the next major catalyst.
why: 比特币在加息预期与油价双重压力下维持震荡，未见明显下跌说明市场已部分消化加息预期；本周五CPI是关键催化剂。对Circle（CRCL）和富途（FUTU）等加密相关持仓，需关注市场情绪转变节点。

title: Broadcom Q3 Revenue +85% YoY to $29.6B; AI Chip Revenue Tripling, FY2027 AI Target $115 Billion
summary: Broadcom fiscal Q3 revenue rose 85% YoY to $29.59B, beating the $29.36B estimate. AI semiconductor revenue tripled in Q3. CEO Hock Tan guided FY2027 AI revenue to $115B (doubling again to $230B in FY2028), backed by custom-chip deals with Google, Meta, and OpenAI. AVGO stock fell slightly on "investors wanted more" reaction.
why: Broadcom业绩揭示AI芯片需求仍在高速增长，对英伟达（NVDA）估值有正面共鸣；同时支撑SK海力士/美光HBM需求前景。AI资本开支周期未见顶、持有科技股的长期逻辑强化；但市场反应平淡（"买预期卖事实"），提示sell call策略需注意位置。

title: Nvidia Agrees to Acquire Hugging Face for ~$13 Billion, Expanding Up the AI Stack
summary: Nvidia agreed to buy open-source AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9B — its second-largest deal ever, after the $20B Groq acquisition. Hugging Face is the leading platform for building and sharing AI models. CEO Jensen Huang: 'Open models matter greatly to our company.' The deal moves Nvidia from chips to AI software/model distribution.
why: 英伟达收购Hugging Face（开源模型最大平台）是战略性向上整合——从硬件到软件生态，强化对AI全栈的控制力。短期NVDA股价催化剂（4天前宣布，可能部分已消化），长期护城河显著拓宽；需关注反垄断审查（AI垄断争议）引入的波动率风险；对sell put策略：NVDA波动率可能因此上升。

title: Xiaomi Confirms European EV Launch in 2027; Signs MoUs With 8 German Dealers at IFA Berlin
summary: At IFA Berlin 2026, Xiaomi Auto confirmed plans to begin EU sales in 2027, signing memoranda of understanding with 8 major German automotive dealer groups including Emil Frey and LUEG Mobility. The company will face 35.3%+10% EU tariffs as it did not participate in the 2023 anti-subsidy probe. No local manufacturing is planned as a first step.
why: 小米汽车欧洲进入战略公开化：dealer网络签约先行，意味着2027年交付计划落实性增强；欧盟35.3%关税是实质性障碍，但不影响高端定位（Human×Car×Home生态溢价）。对1810.HK持仓：欧洲故事为中期估值催化剂，近期还有今日（9月7日）国内秋季发布会（澎程EREV+18 Fold）提供短期驱动。

title: Meituan Q2 Snaps Losing Streak With Profitable June Quarter; Delivery Price War Easing Faster Than Expected
summary: Meituan returned to profitability in Q2 2026, with revenue rising ~21% YoY. The food-delivery price war eased more quickly than anticipated, with Alibaba and JD also narrowing quick-commerce losses. Bloomberg: analyst earnings estimates for the period surged, potentially reviving China delivery-sector stocks after months of valuation compression. Douyin competition is flagged as ongoing risk.
why: 美团季度扭亏是重大转折信号：价格战退潮+即时零售放量双重验证盈利拐点。对3690.HK持仓：sell put行权价安全边际明显提升；Douyin外卖仍是潜在压力，但竞争烈度下降趋势若持续，估值修复空间大。需留意9月15日前后的具体财报数据。

title: 携程同程股价年内跌超40%！业绩增长却遭跳水，OTA估值逻辑被重写
summary: 截至2026年9月初，携程集团(9961.HK)和同程旅行股价年内均下跌逾40%。尽管整体营收保持增长，国内酒店ADR（平均日房价）持续下行导致佣金收入受压，OTA板块市盈率已压缩至12–16倍历史低位。携程77.27亿元反垄断罚款虽于7月27日落地、解除监管悬念，但供给过剩引发的酒店价格战仍是核心结构性问题。
why: 9月15日Q2财报是近期最关键催化剂：若ADR企稳则有估值修复机会；若继续下行则行权价下方风险暴露更大。对携程9961.HK持仓（sell put为主）：建议财报前维持保守、财报后根据ADR数据再重新评估行权价位。

title: Samsung and SK Hynix Set to Widen Memory Chip Lead Over China Through 2028; HBM4 Mass Shipments Underway
summary: South Korea's memory chip output advantage over China is set to grow significantly, with new Samsung and SK Hynix plants adding ~600,000 wafers/month capacity by 2028. SK Hynix confirmed HBM4 mass shipments began in Q2 2026 and HBM4E sample shipments in H1. Nvidia locked down SK Hynix's HBM supply as part of a $500B AI deal with SK Group.
why: SK海力士的HBM4领先地位持续巩固：中国追赶进度落后、韩国产能扩张确保AI芯片HBM供应稳定。对持有SK海力士（000660）或通过美光（MU）间接暴露存储赛道的策略：AI基础设施建设周期延长、HBM需求能见度高。短期风险是加息压力可能压制半导体估值。
